name: quickset-done
description: THE 4/4-BUT-LOCKED STATE (mobile UX audit P0-1, capture request #8). qa_quickset has finished Quick Set across all four positions in both formats — tiers_saved is QB/RB/WR/TE and tier_overrides holds a real 96-player board — but has ZERO trio interactions and ranking_method NULL, because the default route (Rank -> Quick Set Tiers) never visits the chooser that writes it. LeagueScreen's ring counts a position ranked when it is tier-saved, so it reads 4/4; /api/rankings/progress sees ranking_method NULL, falls to the trio branch, finds 0 of the 40 required interactions, and answers unlocked:false. Everything keyed to the unlock stays dark - most consequentially the push-permission prompt, which is gated on progress.unlocked in RootNav. Also the only profile that seeds tier_overrides, which is what the public profile page renders from, so it doubles as the populated-profile fixture under flags/profiles-on.
